Subject: your intake coordinator role

Hi Dana,

Saw Brightwell Law is hiring an intake coordinator. More intake usually means more client detail moving through more tools, and more questions about where it ends up.

We built an AI legal assistant platform for research and document help for a legal-tech venture.

Worth a look?

Sam
Nextron AI

Not relevant? Reply "no" and I won't write again.

Subject: Opinion 512 and intake

Hi Dana,

A different angle. ABA Formal Opinion 512 says a lawyer needs the client's informed consent before putting client information into a self-learning generative AI tool.

Is that shaping how Brightwell thinks about AI for intake?

Sam
Nextron AI

Not relevant? Reply "no" and I won't write again.

We rolled out Microsoft Copilot across the firm in the spring, so we're covered on the AI side.

Dana
